name: A solo project
goal: {{project}} Done when every line of DONE.md is met and you have decided to publish it.

template.title: Solo project
template.summary: One person: a list of what done means written first, the work, a review of your own work with fresh eyes, and a decision before anything is published.
template.whenToUse: You work alone on something you will put in front of other people, and you tend either to keep polishing or to publish too soon.
template.notFor: Work with a second person available to review it (use team-handoffs).

slots.ask: What are you making? One or two sentences.
slots.example: A one-page website for my woodworking, with six photographs and a way to reach me.

description: A plan for one person; no step here is an agent's. You write down what you will make and how you will know it is done, before you start. You make it. Then you come back later, the next day if you can, and read your own work against that list as if someone else had made it, and it goes back to you while a line is not met. Before anything is published you stop and decide, because publishing cannot be taken back. Nothing here needs a coding harness.

nodes.name: Write what done means
nodes.brief: Before you start, write what you are making in two sentences, and under it a short list of things that will be true when it is done, each one something you could point at. Add what you will not do. Three to seven lines: this is the list you will be held to.
outputs: DONE.md: what you are making, and what will be true when it is done

nodes.name: Make it
nodes.brief: Make what DONE.md describes. Stop when you believe every line is met, not when you run out of ideas. On a later round, start from your review and deal with each line that was not met.

nodes.name: Review it with fresh eyes
nodes.brief: Come back after a break, the next day if you can. Read the work against DONE.md as if someone else had made it, one line each: met, with where to see it, or not met. Fix nothing in this step: write it down and take it back to the making. Verdict pass when every line is met.
outputs: REVIEW.md: one line for each line of DONE.md, and a verdict line

nodes.name: Decide to publish
nodes.prompt: Every line of DONE.md is met. Do you publish it at {{where}}? Once it is out, it is out.

nodes.name: Publish it
nodes.brief: Put the work out at {{where}}, and write down where it is and when it went out. Check it from somewhere else, as a visitor would see it.

bar.name: What done means
bar.acceptance: Every line of DONE.md is met, and you can point to where.
